title: Obys — case page: the lens closes, the work becomes a column on the right
note: Clicking the framed image fades the strip, closes the brackets back into one lens at the centre and lays the case out as a long column of big images filling the right half. The left half keeps only the title, category, services and a "Case Study" link on the centre line, plus "Back" bottom left. The lens's difference blend inverts its right half wherever it overlaps the images. Worth reusing: the case page keeps the home page's centre-line layout, so arriving on it feels like zooming in rather than leaving the page.
